title: Cl2− chemical ionization mass spectrometry (Cl2-CIMS) for the measurement of acyl peroxy radicals
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,690-702
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00043B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tyson C. Berg, Michael F. Link, Delphine K. Farmer
Organic peroxy radicals are critical to our understanding of atmospheric oxidation but difficult to measure. We developed Cl2-CIMS, a reagent ion system for laboratory measurements of select organic peroxy radicals.
